description: Hello! I am participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge from Khulna. For this hackathon, I am working on the challenge "Be An Earth System Trend Detective!". My project focuses on analyzing NASA climate and weather datasets using Python and Streamlit to build an interactive coastal climate trend explorer for the Khulna and Sundarbans region. I am participating as a solo developer, ready to build an innovative earth observation dashboard.
